title: Who are you? (character creation)
by: Dev (local model), checked by the writing room

items.ask: Where did you first see the light of day?
answers: In Eliet, in sight of the shaft.
In the hills, among the herders.
Under a sect's roof, a servant's child.
On the road -- never two nights in the same place.

items.ask: When trouble came to your door, what did you do?
answers: Stood in front of the others.
Hit first, and hardest.
I was already round the back.
Talked until it went away.

items.ask: What did your hands do most, growing up?
answers: Carried, dug and hauled.
Quick work: knots, locks, other people's pockets.
Very little. I sat, and listened, and breathed.
A bit of everything, none of it well.

items.ask: What keeps you from sleeping at night?
answers: Being weak when it matters.
Being caught.
Being forgotten.
Being alone.

items.ask: Why do you seek to delve into the depths below Eliet?
answers: For Eliet. Someone has to.
For power. I'm tired of being small.
For the truth of what's down there.
Someone I loved went down and didn't come back.

items.ask: Which trait best describes your nature?
answers: Patient. I can wait out anything.
Fierce. I don't back down.
Careful. I check twice.
Restless. I'm already moving.

items.ask: What parts of yourself do you think the road will change?
answers: Nothing. I know exactly who I am.
A little. I know mostly.
All of it. The road will tell me.
